phase: Phase 28: Dedicated UI/UX Evolution (Tactile Sub-Screens & Overlays)

stories.title: Android Tactile Offline Trail Sheet & File Manager Modernization
stories.description: Refactor OfflineTrailCockpitSheet.kt and TrailFileManagerSheet.kt in :app:sharedUI to integrate IntercomTokens, claymorphic container surfaces, neobrutalist borders, and 84dp glove-friendly touch targets with monospaced tabular telemetry for elevation, distance, and waypoint coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: OfflineTrailCockpitSheet and TrailFileManagerSheet styled with IntercomTokens and TactileModifiers (claymorphic + neobrutalistBorder)
Monospaced tabular coordinates and elevation readouts for jitter-free viewing
Glove-friendly 84dp action buttons and waypoint chips
Zero regressions in JVM unit tests and Android assemble

stories.title: Android Tactile Message Dialog & Subsystem Diagnostics Modernization
stories.description: Refactor MessageHistoryDialog.kt and create TactileDiagnosticsSheet.kt in :app:sharedUI with neobrutalist message bubbles, tabular network telemetry (Q_link, RSSI, loss, jitter, battery duty-cycle), and wire diagnostics toggle into MainCockpitScreen.kt.
acceptanceCriteria: MessageHistoryDialog updated with high-contrast neobrutalist bubbles and quick text chips
TactileDiagnosticsSheet provides real-time tabular breakdown of link quality and RF duty cycle
Diagnostics accessible from MainCockpitScreen header or navigation bar

stories.title: iOS Native SwiftUI Trail Cockpit, File Manager & Diagnostics Modernization
stories.description: Modernize iOS OfflineTrailCockpitSheet, TrailFileManagerSheet, and SubsystemDiagnosticsSheetView in ContentView.swift using TactileDesignSystem, .liquidGlassBackground(), and .neobrutalistOutline() adhering strictly to Rule 1 (100% Native SwiftUI).
acceptanceCriteria: 100% Native SwiftUI without shared Compose UI (Rule 1)
Secondary sheets use .liquidGlassBackground() and neobrutalist outline styling
Tactile haptic clicks wired into sheet button actions
Clean compilation on iOS simulator target

stories.title: Multiplatform Sub-Screen E2E Interaction Test & Certification
stories.description: Implement SubScreenInteractionTest.kt in :app:sharedUI verifying modal dialog toggles, trail waypoint operations, diagnostics rendering, and execute full multiplatform build verification gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Comprehensive interaction test verifying sub-screen state transitions
100% test pass across all multiplatform test tasks
Clean Android assemble and iOS simulator compilation (Rule 6)
